name: Words into Music API
description: Create songs from ideas or lyrics using your existing Words into Music account. Sign up at https://wordsintomusic.com/create/ and create a key in https://wordsintomusic.com/app/settings/. API access has no separate subscription. Starting a song uses one existing song credit. Key holders can access their own private library. English, Spanish, German, French and Brazilian Portuguese are supported.
